page.layout: One printed page, rotated on the scan. Running head at top left; page number at top right; a framed oval engraved portrait with a circular inscription around it; a four-line verse caption printed below the portrait.

main_text.l: Belgis ruinam. Crimi nis sed Rex mei

page.notes: The oval inscription around the portrait reads "ANTONIVS PERENOTTVS, CARDINALIS GRANVEL." with the lettering partly obscured by the cardinal's hat; the first word is partly cut off at the left and is read here from context. The verse caption at the foot is set in italic and bold type; "Crimi nis" is printed with a space and the final line ends in a hyphen at the line end and continues beyond the visible scan. The caption's last line is cut off by the edge of the scan. The engraving is a portrait of a cardinal in a cardinal's hat and cape, described rather than transcribed.
